name: Igra nachalas'
source: It's summer. You and your classmates are sent on an unexpected vacation to Camp Bolashak. Suddenly, you all wake up in an unfamiliar place, a replica of your school! "Jester" appears, welcoming you to a game where you need to earn a certain number of points to escape and survive. Most of the points are awarded for unsolved murders, turning the game into a classic detective game! Investigate the murder, face trials and executions by Houseov to uncover the mystery of this game and open the door to the EXIT. "The Game Has Started" is an indie horror detective game with visual novel elements. Investigate the murder, prepare for trials, and build diverse relationships with the characters! The game perfectly matches the aesthetics of vintage retro visual novels. Try experiencing them face to face, because *they* will remember who you really are.
translation: 现在是夏天。你和你的同学被送往波拉沙克营度过一个意想不到的假期。突然，你们都在一个陌生的地方醒来，这是你们学校的复制品！“小丑”出现，欢迎你进入游戏，你需要获得一定数量的积分才能逃脱并生存。大部分分数都是针对未侦破的谋杀案而授予的，将游戏变成了经典的侦探游戏！调查谋杀案，面对豪索夫的审判和处决，揭开游戏的谜团并打开出口之门。《游戏开始》是一款带有视觉小说元素的独立恐怖侦探游戏。调查谋杀案，准备审判，并与角色建立多样化的关系！该游戏完美契合复古视觉小说的美学。尝试面对面地体验他们，因为*他们*会记住你的真实身份。
